written_by_evidence: platform/workers/mini-worker/runs_filer.py files these records from run_kit.index.scan() over runs/ — PLANE-19 (runs filer), carded 2026-10-07; the worker tick ships switched off (worker.py RUNS_FILER_ON = False)
title: Component runs — what ran, when, held or not
note: Metadata only. The first time a machine is filed, every run then present folds into ONE snapshot record (item <machine>--history), filed once and never re-filed; afterwards each run not in that folded set gets one record of its own. No date or mtime decides the split (PLANE-19 (runs filer) round 2). state is 'unverified' until RKIT-1 (run-kit honest) lands.

verdict_fields.note: the component that ran, its runs/ segment mapped to its folder name (runs/research is research-gatherer)
per-run record only: the brand slot under runs/<machine>/
per-run record only: the run folder's name
per-run record only: the run folder, repo-relative, for example runs/copywriter/Brand B/<label>
per-run record only: 'unverified' when the run's run.json carries a state, null when it carries none; never a verified word until RKIT-1 (run-kit honest) lands
per-run record only: the state word as run.json states it, unverified
per-run record: true when any check.json in the run has a truthy held or a non-empty problems. History snapshot: the count of such runs among those folded
per-run record only: the first 20 file NAMES under the run's deliverable/, never their contents

per-run record only: the run folder's last-changed day, UTC, YYYY-MM-DD — information only; a folder mtime moves on a checkout, so nothing is decided by it and a per-run record is not re-filed when only this moves
history snapshot only: how many runs were folded at the machine's first filing

history snapshot only: the folded set — every run present at the machine's first filing, as sorted '<brand>/<label>' keys. Absent when the list would break the 16KB cap; runs_sha256 and runs_file stand in for it
history snapshot only, when runs is absent: sha256 of the sorted keys as compact JSON

history snapshot only, when runs is absent: the sidecar holding the full folded set, relative to this kind's records directory (_history/<machine>.json) — not a record; the plane reads only the *.json directly in the kind's directory
history snapshot only: folded runs per brand slot
history snapshot only: the earliest changed day among the folded runs, information only
history snapshot only: the latest changed day among the folded runs, information only
history snapshot only: always true, marks the record as a fold of many runs
present only when detail was dropped to fit the 16KB verdict cap, naming what
